source.name: KSL Sports – 'Real Salt Lake Drops New “Switchback” Kit For 2026 Season'
source.quote: The front-of-kit sponsor on the home jersey remains Intermountain Health, which donned the RSL home kit for the first time in 2025.

source.name: KSL Sports – 'Real Salt Lake Drops New “Switchback” Kit For 2026 Season'
source.quote: The left sleeve of the Switchback kit features the RSL-specific MLS logo and the Apple TV logo.
source.note: League-wide patch; Apple TV is on the left sleeve of every MLS club's kit under the Apple–MLS deal.

summary: Adidas 'Switchback' home kit. Intermountain Health fronts the shirt (Select Health had the front in 2024); Apple TV's league-wide patch is on the left sleeve. No right-sleeve sponsor (For Soccer's Feb 2026 audit of all 30 MLS clubs lists none for RSL) and no back-of-jersey sponsor found.
